title: "Before you share"
description: "A short checklist for a readable static website."
author: "Example Author"
date: 2026-01-17
categories: [publishing]
---

## Check the reading experience

- Follow every navigation link.
- Search for a phrase from an article.
- Read the page at a narrow window width.
- Check headings and links using the keyboard.

## Render the complete project

From the repository root, run:

```bash
quarto render 10-website
```

Publish the complete `_site` folder. Keeping just `index.html` omits the other
pages, search index, styles, and scripts.
